title: Group fields with a struct
summary: Swift: Group fields with a struct. Change the page count.
introduction: A struct groups related values. A Book has a title and a page count.
learningObjectives: Group fields with a struct with Swift

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.

blocks.title: Group fields with a struct

blocks.text: The initializer sets pages to 24. Dot access reads that field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A let struct value cannot have its stored fields changed.
